    The quotient construction satisfies the hypotheses of Theorem 2.7 #

    For Q : QuotientData k Λ with one-dimensional tops at e_x, e_y and J^n = 0, the functor F₁ restricted to D_fin is a representation embedding with finite-dimensional values (part (1) of Theorem 3.10 in data form); its retractions (Proposition 4.1) restrict to C_fin. Preservation of indecomposability and reflection of isomorphism classes follow from the retractions on all of D_fin.
